in_urdu.name: الحمیدہ

in_english.name: AlHameedah
in_english.meaning: The ideal woman praiseworthy by everyone
in_english.long_meaning: AlHameedah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'the praiseworthy one' or 'the ideal woman', derived from the Arabic root 'H-M-D', which is also related to the name of Allah 'Al-Hamid', Quranic reference in Surah An-Nisa, verse 96, signifies a woman of impeccable character and morals, whose personality and deeds are praiseworthy in the eyes of all, reflecting virtues of kindness, compassion, and righteousness
